mapper.sql: r.id AS id, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, r.description AS description, r.status AS status, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.is_deleted AS isDeleted, r.deleted_at AS deletedAt, r.deleted_by AS deletedBy

where.if: AND (r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_role r
ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM sys_role r WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT id, role_code, role_name, description, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt, deleted_by AS deletedBy FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, role_code, role_name, description, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt, deleted_by AS deletedBy FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, role_name, description, status) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{description}, #{status})

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id, is_deleted) VALUES
(#{roleId}, #{permissionId}, 0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = 'DB'
mapper.select: SELECT id, perm_code, perm_name, perm_type, parent_id, path, component, icon, sort_no, created_at FROM sys_permission ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ur.user_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(6), deleted_by = COALESCE(#{operatorId}, 'DB') WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_role SET is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = 'DB' WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 1
